name: EPIC 247840229
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 10.3 solar radii and 1.34 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247840229 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.26555 (16th-84th percentiles 9.982591-10.570428), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,004 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.34 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,658 K at its surface.
